item.title: Top House Democratic leader rallies troops in Hartford for U.S. Rep. John Larson
item.description: Facing his toughest election in more than two decades, U.S. Rep. John B. Larson brought the top House Democratic leader to Hartford on Thursday night to rally the troops as he prepares for a highly competitive primary. House leader Hakeem Jeffries of Brooklyn, N.Y. delivered a pep talk to more than 200 Larson supporters as Larson is battling in a four-way Democratic primary after holding his seat for 27 years.
